_comment: Evidence-based MITRE ATT&CK mapping rules. Technique IDs verified against attack.mitre.org. A rule fires only when the detected window actually contains the listed CloudTrail evidence (counts are per 32-event window). If no rule fires, the result is 'No confident MITRE mapping'. This layer is SEPARATE from the GRU-Autoencoder: the model produces the anomaly score, this module interprets the window contents.

rules.rationale: Creation of additional cloud credentials (access keys, console login profiles, imported key pairs) inside the detected window is direct evidence of account manipulation for persistent access.
IAM policy or group membership changes observed in the detected window indicate manipulation of account permissions.

rules.technique_name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs
rules.rationale: CloudTrail logging was stopped, deleted, or reconfigured in the detected window - an adversary hiding activity from audit logs.
A new IAM user was created inside the detected window - creating a cloud account for persistent access.
IAM users or access keys were deleted in the detected window, removing other principals' access.

rules.tactic: Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Defense Evasion
rules.rationale: Console sign-in with valid credentials observed in a window the model scored as anomalous - abuse of legitimate cloud accounts.
Repeated IAM account/policy enumeration (3+ lookups) inside the detected window indicates cloud account discovery.
Repeated IAM policy/role enumeration (5+ lookups) inside the detected window indicates permission-group discovery in the cloud account.
Heavy cloud resource enumeration (10+ Describe/List calls) inside the detected window indicates infrastructure discovery.
Repeated S3 bucket metadata enumeration (8+ calls) inside the detected window indicates cloud storage discovery.
Burst of EC2 RunInstances (8+) inside a window the model scored as anomalous indicates possible compute-resource abuse (e.g. crypto-mining provisioning).

rules.tactic: Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Defense Evasion
rules.rationale: Sustained API activity under assumed roles inside the detected window indicates continued use of valid cloud credentials; mapped only when no more specific credential technique applies.
